overview: The two divisions of the autonomic nervous system, generally working as opposites to balance the body's internal state.
genZNote: Sympathetic: fight or flight, adrenaline mode. Parasympathetic: rest and digest, chill mode.

aspects.label: Overall Effect
aspects.valueA: Prepares the body for 'fight or flight' — increases heart rate, dilates pupils, diverts blood to muscles.
aspects.valueB: Promotes 'rest and digest' — decreases heart rate, stimulates digestion, conserves energy.

overlay.examHighYieldNote: Both systems are always active to some degree; it's the balance between them that determines the body's response at any given moment.
overlay.commonMisconception: These two systems don't simply switch on and off — they work in constant dynamic balance (autonomic tone), not an either/or toggle.
